title: Desk Reference Card — What Each Cartwise Gift Card Pays For
content:
Alcohol lines are never payable with any Cartwise Gift Cards card type; shopper tips are payable with all six; Cartwise+ fees are payable with every type except the Cartwise Holiday Bonus Gift Card. The card below sets out, per card type, what the card can pay for on the platform and the redemption figures that apply to it.

## Acceptance by card type

| Card type | Alcohol lines | Shopper tips | Cartwise+ fees | Most one card pays toward one order | Gift cards combinable on one order |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cartwise eGift Card | Not payable | Payable | Payable | 500.00 | 5 |
| Cartwise Plastic Gift Card | Not payable | Payable | Payable | 200.00 | 5 |
| Cartwise Reloadable Gift Card | Not payable | Payable | Payable | 1000.00 | 5 |
| Cartwise Holiday Bonus Gift Card | Not payable | Payable | Not payable | 300.00 | 5 |
| Cartwise Corporate Gift Card | Not payable | Payable | Payable | 500.00 | 5 |
| Cartwise Corporate Premium Gift Card | Not payable | Payable | Payable | 2000.00 | 5 |

Amounts are in US dollars.

## Redemption features common to every card type

| Feature | Setting for all six card types |
|---|---|
| Card PIN needed to redeem | Yes |
| Retailers that accept the card | Every retailer on the platform |
| Redeemed value moves to the customer's Cartwise account balance | No — the value stays on the card |

## Points of reference

- **Per-order figure.** "Most one card pays toward one order" is a limit per card, per order: it caps the amount that one card contributes toward one order.
- **Combining cards.** Up to 5 gift cards can be combined on one order, for every card type.
- **Account balance.** Redeeming a Cartwise Gift Cards card never converts its value into a balance on the customer's Cartwise account.
- **Retailers.** Acceptance is not limited to particular partner stores; the card is accepted at every retailer.

### Illustration (hypothetical order lines)

| Hypothetical line on an order | Payable with a Cartwise eGift Card? | Payable with a Cartwise Holiday Bonus Gift Card? |
|---|---|---|
| Groceries | Yes | Yes |
| A bottle of wine | No | No |
| Shopper tip | Yes | Yes |
| Cartwise+ membership fee | Yes | No |
